title: fed: MUST be prepared to receive rich text in Peer/deliver
description: New message validation step 6 says servers implementing JMAP-CHAT that support application/jmap-chat-rich 'MUST be prepared to receive it in Peer/deliver.' This is implementation readiness guidance that cannot be verified at the protocol level. A server that doesn't support rich text simply won't list it in supportedBodyTypes and will reject it at step 6. The MUST adds nothing over the existing validation. Decision: downgrade to SHOULD, or remove entirely as redundant with the supportedBodyTypes check.
close_reason: Removed 'MUST be prepared to receive it in Peer/deliver' as redundant — the supportedBodyTypes gate in step 6 already handles this: servers that support rich text list it and accept it; servers that don't list it reject with invalidArguments.
